name: urbancart
description: UrbanCart — Cloudflare Workers + D1 + Pages E-Commerce

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix worker && npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix admin
scripts.deploy:client: npm run build:client && CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID=afeeea28ef4b58aad33f54322feaab68 npx wrangler pages deploy client/dist --project-name=urbancart --commit-dirty=true
scripts.deploy:admin: npm run build:admin && CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID=afeeea28ef4b58aad33f54322feaab68 npx wrangler pages deploy admin/dist --project-name=urbancart-admin --commit-dirty=true
